sourceChat.title: Alexa mit Jarvis verbinden
sourceChat.method: Bounded read_thread pages, filtered original user/assistant messages. No write or message to that chat.

deltas.acceptance: Configured expiry closes only the originating preview generation; manual reopen survives old timers; failed stream returns without claiming live video.

deltas.feature: Follow-up conversation window after audio completion
deltas.acceptance: Speaking -> FollowUpWindow -> Closed uses actual audio completion; replacing the session invalidates old expiry/completion events; historic duration is not silently made a NEOTH default.

deltas.feature: One visible progress record per incoming message
deltas.acceptance: Exact account/message/run identity owns one status record and terminal state across retry/restart; unknown external outcome never triggers blind resend.

deltas.feature: Observed audio route and bounded recovery
deltas.acceptance: Desired route differs from observed route; disconnect/reconnect recovery is bounded, old callbacks are rejected, capture is released; OS route proof is not human audibility.
Selecting a tool is not completion; cards carry actual observed terminal state and a bounded fallback reason.

deltas.feature: Separate photo capture and recipient-bound delivery
deltas.acceptance: Capture creates no implicit send; delivery needs the existing exact destination/subject/authority binding and receipt.
Optional only when a concrete authorized connector exists: compose, required confirmation, chime, delivery, typed terminal; accepted does not mean audibly played.
